rows.note: Use 解剖 for the literal cutting-open and examination of a body.

example.english: In biology class, the teacher demonstrated a dissection of a frog.
example.traditional: 生物堂上，老師示範點樣解剖一隻青蛙。
example.jyutping: sang1 mat6 tong4 soeng6 lou5 si1 si6 faan6 dim2 joeng2 gaai2 fau2 jat1 zek3 cing1 waa1

rows.note: Use 分析 for a careful, detailed examination of an issue; it is the all-purpose choice for the figurative sense.

example.english: We did a detailed dissection of the report to find the problem.
example.traditional: 我哋開會逐點分析份報告，搵出問題喺邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2 zuk6 dim2 fan1 sik1 fan6 bou3 gou3 wan2 ceot1 man6 tai4 hai2 bin1
